defaults.sourceDependencies: W02 policy/authority + W03 durable foundation + W04 target-neutral capabilities + W07 execution-target contracts + W14 Device Gateway/session/trust; DP1-DP3 satisfied before implementation
defaults.mission: Android application/runtime: presence/lifecycle, secure device identity/session/Keystore, native capability bridge, installed-app integration, permission/consent broker, Device Executor, voice fast path, offline-safe queue, optional Device Owner/Launcher and physical acceptance.
sources: - Legacy Windows/voice/device references as behavior vocabulary only

tasks.title: W15-00 - Device Plane Coordination & Ownership Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate DP1 W04, DP2 W07 and DP3 W14 accepted contracts plus W02/W03 prerequisites.
2. Freeze apps/aurora-android ownership, native service boundaries, device executor integration and internal W15 DAG.
3. Confirm Android permissions/session/Keystore never substitute Aurora authority.
4. Define DP4/DP5 publication and physical acceptance criteria.
5. Create device-specific premortem/risk register covering replay, permissions, package impersonation, offline queue, privilege and evidence.
tasks.ownership: W15 Android/device runtime governance and W15-owned paths.
tasks.forbidden: Do not redefine DeviceId/DeviceRef, capability registry, PolicyToken, ActionIntent or generic executor semantics.

tasks.title: W15-A - Android Application Foundation, Presence & Lifecycle
actions: 1. Build Android app foundation and supported lifecycle architecture.
2. Implement presence/foreground/background/service state model appropriate to platform constraints.
3. Define secure local configuration and environment separation.
4. Implement connectivity/session lifecycle hooks without implying authority.
5. Add lifecycle/process-death/restart tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement app-specific side effects or authority logic.

tasks.title: W15-B - Device Identity, Registration, Secure Session & Keystore
actions: 1. Consume W14 DeviceId/DeviceRef and registration/session contracts.
2. Implement Android-side registration/session client and secure key material use via Keystore.
3. Support session rotation/revocation/expiry and compromised-device handling.
4. Never serialize secrets into logs/evidence/cache.
5. Add key/session/reinstall/revocation tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create a second device identity namespace or treat Keystore possession as action authority.

tasks.title: W15-C - Native Device Capability Bridge
actions: 1. Implement native capability bridge mapped to W04 capability bindings and W07 target semantics.
2. Expose capability availability/freshness/compatibility/preconditions.
3. Support examples such as app.open, navigation, camera, media, location, file/share, notification only when OS/platform permits.
4. Keep capability discovery separate from execution permission.
5. Add availability/permission/staleness tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create agent-per-app architecture or bypass W07.

tasks.title: W15-D - Installed App Integration Layer
actions: 1. Implement app integration in precedence order: official API/SDK -> Intent/App Link/Deep Link -> governed app adapter -> Accessibility/computer-use fallback only if explicitly high-risk governed.
2. Resolve package/app availability and supported actions safely.
3. Validate deep links/intents and protect against package impersonation.
4. Define readback/evidence capability where app/OS allows.
5. Add app-missing/wrong-package/deep-link tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not silently use Accessibility for convenience.

tasks.title: W15-E - Permission & Consent Broker
actions: 1. Implement Android runtime permission state/precondition broker.
2. Map local permission/consent state to capability availability without changing Aurora authority.
3. Handle denied/permanently denied/revoked/background restrictions.
4. Ensure permission prompts occur only in appropriate UX context.
5. Add permission drift and denial tests.

tasks.title: W15-F - Device Executor Runtime
actions: 1. Implement Android device-target executor consuming W07-compatible authorized ActionIntent/target requests.
2. Validate target/session/capability/permission/preconditions before native action.
3. Execute native/app action and return Receipt/Evidence/readback.
4. Classify ambiguous outcome as EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN and reconcile-before-retry.
5. Support kill switch/cancellation and bounded execution.
tasks.forbidden: Do not bypass current policy/authority or execute direct planner/model commands.

tasks.title: W15-G - Voice / Wake / Presence Fast Path
actions: 1. Implement voice/wake/presence loop for deterministic common commands.
2. Separate speech recognition/intent inference from action authority.
3. Use fast path only for capability/policy-safe deterministic flows.
4. Escalate ambiguity/high-risk commands and respect lifecycle/privacy constraints.
5. Add wake false-positive, transcript ambiguity and permission tests.
tasks.forbidden: Voice confidence cannot grant permission or bypass W07/W15-F.

tasks.title: W15-H - Offline-Safe Queue, Reconnect, Dedupe & Reconciliation
actions: 1. Implement offline queue only for actions safe to defer/reconcile.
2. Use W03 durable/idempotency semantics and W14 reconnect/session rules.
3. Deduplicate commands across reconnect/process restart.
4. Never blindly replay EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN or stale-authority commands; revalidate required current state.
5. Test prolonged offline, stale session, duplicate queue and late receipt.
tasks.forbidden: Do not cache executable authority beyond validity/current-policy requirements.

tasks.title: W15-I - Optional Device Owner / Aurora Launcher Profile
actions: 1. Evaluate whether dedicated-device/Device Owner/Launcher mode solves a concrete deployment requirement.
2. Implement only if justified by explicit deployment profile and platform feasibility.
3. Separate optional privileged profile from standard app architecture.
4. Document elevated permissions, rollback/recovery and security implications.
5. Add provisioning/unprovisioning tests if implemented.
tasks.forbidden: Do not make Device Owner mandatory or use elevated privilege to bypass Aurora policy.

tasks.title: W15-J - Physical Device Integration, Security & Acceptance
actions: 1. Run physical Android integration across lifecycle, registration/session, native/app capabilities, permission denial, offline/reconnect and voice.
2. Test missing app, revoked session, stale capability, duplicate command, late receipt, EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN and kill switch.
3. Run four Risk Gates plus device-specific threat scenarios owned now vs deferred to W19.
4. Run performance/battery/resource observations appropriate to tablet target.
5. Close DP4/DP5 only with exact-head evidence and W14/W17 handoffs.
tasks.forbidden: Do not claim Release 1.0; final device security/release remains W19/W20.
